_comment: Predefined VirtualPyTest Grafana alert rules. Applied by scripts/grafana_alerts.py; documented in docs/user-guide/grafana-alerting.md and docs/agent/infra/GRAFANA_ALERTING.md. Each query returns one row per series: text columns become alert labels, the numeric column `value` is compared against `threshold`. {{team_id}} is substituted at apply time. Zero rows = healthy (noDataState OK). A rule's `requires` lists tables it reads; apply skips the rule while one is missing (migration not applied yet).

rules.title: Host stopped reporting
rules.summary: {{ $labels.host_name }} has not reported metrics for {{ printf "%.0f" $values.A.Value }} min
rules.description: No system_metrics row from host {{ $labels.host_name }} (server {{ $labels.server_name }}) for more than 10 minutes. The host service is down, the machine is off, or it lost network. A host that stays silent for 3 days drops out of the query and the alert resolves on its own.
rules.sql:
SELECT m.server_name, m.host_name,
       greatest(0, extract(epoch FROM now() - m.last_ts) / 60)::float AS value
FROM (SELECT coalesce(server_name, '') AS server_name, host_name, max("timestamp") AS last_ts
      FROM system_metrics
      WHERE "timestamp" > now() - interval '3 days'
      GROUP BY server_name, host_name) m
WHERE NOT (m.host_name = 'server' AND EXISTS (
  -- a server used to report under the literal name 'server' and now reports under its SERVER_NAME:
  -- the old series is a ghost, not a host that stopped
  SELECT 1 FROM system_metrics s
  WHERE coalesce(s.server_name, '') = m.server_name AND s.host_name <> 'server'
    AND s."timestamp" > now() - interval '15 minutes'))

rules.title: Host disk almost full
rules.description: Root disk of host {{ $labels.host_name }} (server {{ $labels.server_name }}) is above 85%. Captures and reports stop being written when it is full.
rules.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT ON (server_name, host_name)
       coalesce(server_name, '') AS server_name, host_name, disk_percent::float AS value
FROM system_metrics
WHERE "timestamp" > now() - interval '15 minutes'
ORDER BY server_name, host_name, "timestamp" DESC

rules.title: Host memory high
rules.description: Memory use of host {{ $labels.host_name }} (server {{ $labels.server_name }}) has stayed above 90% for 15 minutes.
rules.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT ON (server_name, host_name)
       coalesce(server_name, '') AS server_name, host_name, memory_percent::float AS value
FROM system_metrics
WHERE "timestamp" > now() - interval '15 minutes'
ORDER BY server_name, host_name, "timestamp" DESC

rules.title: Host CPU too hot
rules.description: CPU temperature of host {{ $labels.host_name }} is above 80 °C. A Raspberry Pi starts throttling around 80-85 °C, which slows capture. Only hosts that report a temperature are checked.
rules.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT ON (server_name, host_name)
       coalesce(server_name, '') AS server_name, host_name, cpu_temperature_celsius::float AS value
FROM system_metrics
WHERE "timestamp" > now() - interval '15 minutes' AND cpu_temperature_celsius IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY server_name, host_name, "timestamp" DESC

rules.title: Capture or monitor not running
rules.description: The video capture (ffmpeg) or the monitor of device {{ $labels.device_name }} ({{ $labels.capture_folder }}) on host {{ $labels.host_name }} has not been active for 10 minutes. No incidents are detected for that device while this lasts.
rules.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT ON (host_name, device_id)
       host_name, device_name, capture_folder, ffmpeg_status, monitor_status,
       (CASE WHEN ffmpeg_status = 'active' AND monitor_status = 'active' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END)::float AS value
FROM system_device_metrics
WHERE "timestamp" > now() - interval '15 minutes'
ORDER BY host_name, device_id, "timestamp" DESC

rules.title: Device incident ongoing
rules.description: An incident ({{ $labels.incident_type }}) has been active on device {{ $labels.device_name }} for more than 10 minutes. Not applied by default: an idle device sitting on a static menu reports a long freeze, which is expected.
rules.sql:
SELECT host_name, coalesce(device_name, device_id) AS device_name, incident_type,
       (extract(epoch FROM now() - min(start_time)) / 60)::float AS value
FROM alerts
WHERE status = 'active' AND NOT coalesce(discard, false)
GROUP BY host_name, coalesce(device_name, device_id), incident_type

rules.title: Too many incidents on a device
rules.summary: {{ $labels.device_name }} ({{ $labels.host_name }}): {{ printf "%.0f" $values.A.Value }} incidents in the last hour
rules.description: More than 20 incidents (blackscreen, freeze, audio loss, macroblocks...) started on device {{ $labels.device_name }} in the last hour. The signal is flapping or the device is unstable.
rules.sql:
SELECT host_name, coalesce(device_name, device_id) AS device_name, count(*)::float AS value
FROM alerts
WHERE start_time > now() - interval '1 hour' AND NOT coalesce(discard, false)
  -- triage already decided these: a repeat of a discarded alert, one that resolved within seconds, one that aged out
  AND NOT (check_type = 'ai_strategy_skip' AND (discard_comment LIKE '[SKIP:short]%' OR discard_comment LIKE '[SKIP:expired]%'
           OR (discard_comment LIKE '[SKIP:repeat]%' AND discard_comment LIKE '%(discard)%')))
GROUP BY host_name, coalesce(device_name, device_id)

rules.title: Script failing repeatedly
rules.description: {{ printf "%.0f" $values.A.Value }} script(s) on {{ $labels.device_name }} ({{ $labels.host_name }}) failed their last 3 or more prod runs: {{ $labels.scripts }}. One alert per device, not per script. Resolves when each script passes again. Discarded runs are ignored, and a device that has not run anything for 2 days is left to the host and device-down rules.
rules.sql:
WITH r AS (
  SELECT script_name, host_name, device_name, success, started_at,
         row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY script_name, host_name, device_name ORDER BY started_at DESC) AS rn
  FROM script_results
  WHERE team_id = '{{team_id}}' AND environment = 'prod' AND NOT coalesce(discard, false)
    AND started_at > now() - interval '7 days'
), s AS (
  SELECT script_name, host_name, device_name,
         (coalesce(min(rn) FILTER (WHERE success), max(rn) + 1) - 1) AS streak, max(started_at) AS last_run
  FROM r GROUP BY script_name, host_name, device_name
)
-- one row per device instead of one per script: a dead phone fails all 13 of its scripts and used to send 13 alerts.
-- Only devices that still ran in the last 2 days: a host that stopped running is the host / device-down rules' business
SELECT host_name, device_name, count(*)::float AS value,
       left(string_agg(script_name, ', ' ORDER BY streak DESC, script_name), 90) AS scripts
FROM s
WHERE streak >= 3 AND last_run > now() - interval '2 days'
GROUP BY host_name, device_name

rules.title: Script pass rate dropped
rules.summary: {{ $labels.script_name }} pass rate dropped by {{ printf "%.0f" $values.A.Value }} points
rules.description: The pass rate of {{ $labels.script_name }} ({{ $labels.userinterface_name }}) over the last 24 h is more than 30 points below its previous 7 days. Needs at least 3 runs today and 5 runs in the baseline. Usually a new build of the app or device firmware.
rules.sql:
SELECT script_name, coalesce(userinterface_name, '') AS userinterface_name,
       (100.0 * avg(success::int) FILTER (WHERE started_at <= now() - interval '1 day')
        - 100.0 * avg(success::int) FILTER (WHERE started_at > now() - interval '1 day'))::float AS value
FROM script_results
WHERE team_id = '{{team_id}}' AND environment = 'prod' AND NOT coalesce(discard, false)
  AND started_at > now() - interval '8 days'
GROUP BY script_name, coalesce(userinterface_name, '')
HAVING count(*) FILTER (WHERE started_at > now() - interval '1 day') >= 3
   AND count(*) FILTER (WHERE started_at <= now() - interval '1 day') >= 5

rules.title: Fleet health: device DOWN
rules.description: The latest fleet-health check marks device {{ $labels.device_name }} on host {{ $labels.host_name }} as {{ $labels.verdict }}. Set the threshold to 0 to also be told about DEGRADED devices. The latest check is the 10-minute live one when vpt-fleet-health-live.timer is installed, otherwise the nightly 07:00 one.
rules.sql:
SELECT server, host_name, coalesce(device_name, device_id) AS device_name, verdict,
       (CASE verdict WHEN 'DOWN' THEN 2 WHEN 'DEGRADED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::float AS value
FROM fleet_health
WHERE generated_at = (SELECT max(generated_at) FROM fleet_health)

rules.title: Platform service down
rules.description: Platform component {{ $labels.component }} on {{ $labels.vm }} is down, or has not been checked for more than 3 minutes (stale: the VM agent, the collector or the database stopped answering). component = agent means the VM itself is off or unreachable. Reads service_status_current, the same live table as the System Service Status dashboard. A component that is no longer collected (a renamed or retired server) stays stale for up to a day, then drops out.
rules.sql:
SELECT server_name, vm, component,
       CASE WHEN checked_at < now() - interval '3 minutes' THEN 'stale' ELSE status END AS state,
       (CASE WHEN status = 'down' OR checked_at < now() - interval '3 minutes' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::float AS value
FROM service_status_current
-- service_status_current is the live heartbeat (one row per component, rewritten every minute); service_status is only a
-- change log since 20261001f. A server that was renamed or retired stops writing: after a day it drops out instead of alerting forever
WHERE checked_at > now() - interval '1 day'

rules.title: Platform service degraded
rules.description: Platform component {{ $labels.component }} on {{ $labels.vm }} has reported degraded for 15 minutes (running but not healthy). Opt-in: degraded is often transient.
rules.sql:
SELECT server_name, vm, component, (CASE WHEN status = 'degraded' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::float AS value
FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (server_name, vm, component) server_name, vm, component, status
  FROM service_status
  WHERE checked_at > now() - interval '3 minutes'
  ORDER BY server_name, vm, component, checked_at DESC
) latest

rules.title: Infra VM disk almost full
rules.description: Root disk of infra VM {{ $labels.vm }} (database, storage, frontend, proxy...) is above 85%. A full database or storage disk stops the whole platform.
rules.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT ON (server_name, vm) server_name, vm, disk_percent::float AS value
FROM vm_metrics
WHERE "timestamp" > now() - interval '15 minutes' AND disk_percent IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY server_name, vm, "timestamp" DESC

rules.title: Infra VM memory high
rules.description: Memory use of infra VM {{ $labels.vm }} has stayed above 90% for 15 minutes.
rules.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT ON (server_name, vm) server_name, vm, memory_percent::float AS value
FROM vm_metrics
WHERE "timestamp" > now() - interval '15 minutes' AND memory_percent IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY server_name, vm, "timestamp" DESC
